info.title: Lumeus Activity API
info.description:
Lumeus Activity API on Stellar. Sign up at https://app.lumeus.dev: Free, Starter, Growth and Scale plans are self-serve, Enterprise by agreement.

- **Pricing.** Testnet is free: Testnet requests cost no credits and are never billed. Each organization can make 10,000 Testnet requests a day across Activity, Assets and RPC (unlimited on Enterprise); the count resets at 00:00 UTC, and a request over it answers 429 rate_limited with Retry-After set to the seconds until then. Mainnet requests draw from the plan's monthly credits. Plans, limits and credit weights: `GET https://api.lumeus.dev/v1/plans`.
- **Authentication.** Send `Authorization: Bearer <key>`. Testnet: `lum_test_…`; Mainnet: `lum_live_…`. A key works only on its own network, so pick the server that matches it (the other network answers 401). Publishable `lum_pub_…` keys call the GET data routes only, from an allowed browser origin. Webhook keys (`whk_…`) are not accepted here.
- **Headers.** Every response except `GET /readyz` carries X-Request-Id; authenticated responses carry RateLimit-Limit, RateLimit-Remaining and RateLimit-Reset; 429 and 503 carry Retry-After.
- **Errors.** JSON with a machine-readable code (see [errors](/guides/errors)). A path with an empty, `.` or `..` segment answers 400 invalid_request, a trailing slash answers 404 not_found, and a method the path does not accept answers 405 with an Allow header.
- **CORS.** Browser calls (CORS) are allowed from https://docs.lumeus.dev (the Try it playground of this reference) and https://app.lumeus.dev only, without cookies; responses expose ETag, Link, Location, Retry-After, X-Request-Id, X-Lumeus-Operation-Id, X-Lumeus-Idempotency and RateLimit-Limit, RateLimit-Remaining and RateLimit-Reset (errors included). Other websites cannot read responses made with a server key: use a publishable key with your own allowed origins ([browser keys](/guides/browser-keys)).

get.description:
Returns the token movements (transfer, mint, burn, clawback) and fees in which an address takes part, newest first, over its full history. No ledger range is needed.

- Filter with `direction` and `include_fees`. A page holds up to 1000 records.
- Custom contract events that name the address in a topic are not included: read them from `GET /accounts/{id}/contract-events`.
- A page can also stop early when its payload reads run out of time on cold history or its records reach 16 MiB. Follow `_links.next.href` until `range_complete` is true ([pagination](/activity/pagination)).
- Unknown or repeated query parameters return 400, so a typo or an unsupported filter never returns unfiltered data.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Stellar address: a G account, M muxed account, C contract, B claimable balance or L liquidity pool StrKey. It must be checksum-valid.

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: Sort by ledger: desc (newest first) or asc. The route description gives the default.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Records per page. Larger values are clamped to max_page_size from `GET /v1/plans` (200), or account_max_page_size (1000) on account activity and both topic routes; the page reports the effective value as limit.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Resume after this paging_token. Prefer following `_links.next.href`, which carries the cursor and the snapshot for you.

parameters.name: since_ledger
parameters.description: First ledger of the range, inclusive. Without until_ledger the range runs to the published tip (read_view.snapshot_ledger). A value past the tip returns an empty, complete page whose scanned_through_ledger is the tip.

parameters.name: until_ledger
parameters.description: End of the range, exclusive. Requires since_ledger and must be greater than it. There is no maximum range width.

parameters.name: generation
parameters.description: Index generation from read_view.generation. Send it together with snapshot_ledger to keep a walk on one snapshot; server links already include both.

parameters.name: snapshot_ledger
parameters.description: Read at this published snapshot (read_view.snapshot_ledger of an earlier page). Requires generation. Below read_view.first_ledger it answers 400; above the published tip, 503 index_not_ready.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Optional; reads do not need it. When sent it must be 8 to 128 printable ASCII characters (0x21-0x7E: no spaces or control characters) in one header, otherwise 400. Prepaid accounts use it to recover a read without paying again; for every other account a valid key is accepted and has no effect.

parameters.name: direction
parameters.description: in: records where the account received (to). out: records where it sent (from) or paid the fee. Either value also leaves out the records a contract address emitted and the issuer records of an asset issuer. Default: both directions.

parameters.name: include_fees
parameters.description: false leaves out fee records. Combined with direction=out, only the records the account sent.

200.description: A page of records read from one published snapshot.

X-Request-Id.description: Identifier of this request: req_ followed by 24 hex characters. Error bodies repeat it as request_id. Quote it when contacting support.

RateLimit-Limit.description: Requests per minute of the bucket that answered: the plan rate, the dashboard session floor of 120, or a publishable key's per-IP rate.

RateLimit-Remaining.description: Whole requests left in the bucket after this one.

RateLimit-Reset.description: Seconds until the bucket is full again.
